# Requirements Quality Checklist: Skill Gap Detector & Learning Plan

**Purpose**: Validate requirement quality, completeness, clarity, and error-state definitions for the Skill Gap Detector and Personal Learning Plan.
**Created**: 2026-10-17
**Feature**: [spec.md](file:///e:/OneMoreTime/projects/CWW%20Ai%20Project/skill-bridge-ai/specs/001-skill-gap-platform/spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## 1. AI Output Schemas & Structural Validation

- [ ] CHK001 Are the exact schema fields and data types for the Skill Gap Detector output explicitly specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the numerical range and calculation boundary for the readiness score quantified unambiguously (e.g., integer 0–100)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the allowable values for missing skill priority tiers restricted to an explicit set (High, Medium, Low)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK004 Does the spec specify the expected structure and constraints for the rationale text of each missing skill? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK005 Are weekly curriculum components (theme, topics, tasks, resources, mini-project) exhaustively enumerated for the Learning Plan? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the schema for recommended free learning resources explicitly defined (e.g., title, URL, type)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK007 Are duration selection constraints restricted to discrete week options (2, 4, 8 weeks with 4 as default)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]

## 2. Error, Boundary & Empty States Coverage

- [ ] CHK008 Are visual and functional requirements defined for empty skill submissions or single-character inputs? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge-Cases]
- [ ] CHK009 Does the spec specify user guidance and fallback states when 0% of required skills match? [Edge Case, Coverage, Spec §Edge-Cases]
- [ ] CHK010 Does the spec specify visual feedback when a candidate already has 100% of required skills? [Edge Case, Coverage, Spec §Edge-Cases]
- [ ] CHK011 Are requirements explicitly documented for handling AI timeout or upstream provider errors without freezing the UI? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK012 Are retry mechanisms or user-facing retry actions specified when an analysis request fails? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK013 Are loading skeleton and progress indicator requirements defined for asynchronous gap detection and roadmap generation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK014 Are empty states defined for users viewing the learning plan before any gap analysis has been performed? [Coverage, Spec §FR-017]

## 3. Acceptance Criteria Quality & Measurability

- [ ] CHK015 Can the readiness score calculation and visual gauge display be objectively verified in under 60 seconds? [Measurability, Spec §User Story 1, SC-005]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the transition time from gap detection report to learning plan generation objectively measurable as a single click? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the end-to-end user journey time (landing page to gap report in < 2 minutes) verifiable with measurable start/stop milestones? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK018 Are task checkbox completion rules and readiness score increment calculations quantitatively defined? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §User Story 2, FR-007]
- [ ] CHK019 Are mobile viewport display requirements (e.g., 375px width without horizontal scroll) testable with objective layout bounds? [Non-Functional, Spec §SC-006]

## 4. User Flow & Feature Consistency

- [ ] CHK020 Are target role selection requirements consistent between Onboarding, Gap Detector, and Learning Plan? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, FR-013]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the data flow between missing skills in the gap report and target topics in the learning plan unambiguously mapped? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 2]
- [ ] CHK022 Are guest session persistence expectations consistent across browser reloads for both the gap report and task completion states? [Consistency, Spec §FR-015]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit.implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
